frontmatter.title: The 3 A.M. Beer
frontmatter.summary: A night-shift clerk at a convenience store notices an old man who comes in every night at exactly 3 a.m. to buy the same beer. He never speaks, never changes his order, never explains—until the night he doesn't show up.

frontmatter.title: 凌晨三点钟的啤酒
frontmatter.summary: 便利店的夜班店员发现，每晚凌晨三点，都会有一个老人准时来买同一款啤酒。他不说话，不换口味，也从不解释——直到有一天他没来。

frontmatter.title: The 3 AM Regular
frontmatter.summary: A convenience store night-shift clerk notices a customer who arrives with clockwork precision. The week he disappears, she realizes how concrete loneliness can be.

frontmatter.title: 凌晨三点的常客
frontmatter.summary: 便利店夜班店员注意到一位每天准时出现的客人，他消失的那几天，她才意识到城市的孤独可以有多具体。

frontmatter.title: The Bone Hairpin
frontmatter.summary: Peddler Shen Er passes through Qinglu village by night and trades a measure of rice for a warm white hairpin from a pale old woman—only to learn the village perished in plague the year before.

frontmatter.title: 骨钗
frontmatter.summary: 货郎沈二夜过青芦村，以一斗米换得白发老妪一支温润骨钗，方知那村子去年已因疫尽殁。

frontmatter.title: The City God
frontmatter.summary: A new City God tries a wrongful case of thirty years; his verdict, to all surprise, gives back to the living what was taken.

frontmatter.title: 城隍
frontmatter.summary: 新任城隍夜审三十年积冤，出人意料的判词，竟是还生者以所夺。

frontmatter.title: The Clam Spirit
frontmatter.summary: A clam-diver finds a giant shell; by night a woman tells of her former life, and where her pearls fall a red light is born.

frontmatter.title: 蚌精
frontmatter.summary: 采蚌人得巨蚌，夜有女子诉前身，珠落处红光起。

frontmatter.title: The Crane Immortal
frontmatter.summary: A sick old man is saved by a crane that bears a crimson pellet; when healed he sets it free, and where the crane goes, the man soon follows.

frontmatter.title: 鹤仙
frontmatter.summary: 病叟得仙鹤衔丹相救，愈后放鹤，鹤去人亦遁世。

frontmatter.title: The Direction of Three O'Clock
frontmatter.summary: A late-night convenience store clerk notices a young man who appears every night at 3 a.m., standing under a streetlamp and staring at the same window. Hanging there is a red wind chime.

frontmatter.title: 三点钟的方向
frontmatter.summary: 深夜便利店的老店员发现，每天凌晨三点，总有一个年轻人站在路灯下，面朝同一扇窗户。窗户上挂着一个红色风铃。

frontmatter.title: The Dragon Girl
frontmatter.summary: A fisher saves a wounded woman adrift; she is a dragon-king's daughter, and repays him with a bushel of bright pearls before she goes.

frontmatter.title: 龙女
frontmatter.summary: 风暴中救起浮桅女子，乃龙王之女；报以一斛明珠，临水化龙而去。

frontmatter.title: The Elevator in Building Seven, Unit Two
frontmatter.summary: For twenty years, Old Zhou fixed elevators. The one in Building Seven was the only one he never managed to repair — because it wasn't the elevator that was broken.

frontmatter.title: 七栋二单元的电梯
frontmatter.summary: 老周修了二十年电梯，唯独七栋二单元那部，他始终修不好——因为坏的不是电梯。

frontmatter.title: The Final Walkthrough
frontmatter.summary: On moving-out day, the landlord brought a handwritten checklist he'd been using for twenty-eight years. She had lived there three years, yet knew far less about the apartment than the old man who had spent decades listening to footsteps from the floor below.

frontmatter.title: 退租
frontmatter.summary: 退租那天，房东带来一张用了二十八年的手写清单。她住了三年，却发现自己对这套房子的了解，远不如这位在楼下听了二十八年脚步声的老人。

frontmatter.title: The Fishpond
frontmatter.summary: The fishpond owner finds fish vanishing by count and, watching all night, meets a widow keeping a door for her drowned grandson.

frontmatter.title: 鱼塘
frontmatter.summary: 鱼塘主老陶发现鱼总按数少，蹲守一夜，看见寡居的桂婶在替淹死的孙子“认门”。

frontmatter.title: The Flower Spirit
frontmatter.summary: The aged Wei-Purple peony turns to a spirit and loves the boy who waters her; when the bloom falls she returns, and her scent lingers on his robe.

frontmatter.title: 花妖
frontmatter.summary: 魏紫牡丹成妖，恋一浇花少年，花落人归，香独留衣袂经旬。

frontmatter.title: The Fox Concubine
frontmatter.summary: A poor scholar takes a fox for his concubine; gentle and knowing—until office and riches reveal her true design.

frontmatter.title: 狐妾
frontmatter.summary: 雪夜拾狐，温柔解语成妾；一旦得禄，真身却随月色而去。

frontmatter.title: The Fox Inkstone
frontmatter.summary: A poor scholar's inkstone fills itself each night—the debt of a grandfather's three generations past, owed to the house of Fox.

frontmatter.title: 狐砚
frontmatter.summary: 穷书生砚台每夜自盈墨，原是三世前祖父欠下狐家一纸科第之债。

frontmatter.title: The Fox Transform
frontmatter.summary: The beauty who knocks at moonless nights is a great fox; the one who sees her true shape and does not flee reveals her loneliness.

frontmatter.title: 狐变
frontmatter.summary: 月晦扣扉之美人，竟是巨狐，见其本相者独不惧，反令妖露其孤。

frontmatter.title: The Fox Wedding
frontmatter.summary: On a moonless night a curious youth peeps at a fox-wedding procession and earns a burning glance.

frontmatter.title: 狐嫁
frontmatter.summary: 月晦之夜，少年阿青窥见狐族娶亲的红灯彩轿，一瞥几遭不测。

frontmatter.title: The Ghost-Doctor
frontmatter.summary: Amid a great plague a nameless white-robed physician comes by night to ply his needle; at dawn men learn he died for medicine thirty years past.

frontmatter.title: 鬼医
frontmatter.summary: 大疫之中，无名白衣夜来施针，天明人方知其为三十年前殉医之鬼。

frontmatter.title: The Grave Neighbor
frontmatter.summary: A poor scholar rents a room whose only neighbor is a ruined grave—and speaks with its dweller for years.

frontmatter.title: 墓邻
frontmatter.summary: 一寒士赁屋而居，邻是荒坟，竟与坟中人对谈数载。

frontmatter.title: The Judge
frontmatter.summary: A grasping official dreams himself before the Judge of the Dead, who weighs his heart and shows him the life to come.

frontmatter.title: 判官
frontmatter.summary: 一贪吏夜梦入阴司，判官以秤称其心，示以来世之报，惊汗而寤。

frontmatter.title: The Keys
frontmatter.summary: The building keeper holds every key; the one Teacher Zhou entrusted him opens a door no one wanted to face.

frontmatter.title: 看门人的钥匙
frontmatter.summary: 看门人老孙握着整栋楼的钥匙，终于用周老师托付的那把，打开了一扇谁也不愿面对的门。

frontmatter.title: Beneath the Lamp
frontmatter.summary: An old oil-lamp makes whoever sits beneath it forget their regrets—and the loves that went with them.

frontmatter.title: 灯下
frontmatter.summary: 一盏旧油灯，灯下坐者会渐渐忘掉心中所憾——连同所爱。

frontmatter.title: The Lantern Charm
frontmatter.summary: Each night a woman's shadow appears by the lamp, brightening and fading with its flame, and draws out a regret of verses burned long ago.

frontmatter.title: 灯魅
frontmatter.summary: 灯下每现一女子影，随灯火明灭，牵出一桩旧年焚稿之憾。

frontmatter.title: The Last Bus
frontmatter.summary: Every night at 11:40, the last No. 37 bus passes through the old district. Fewer and fewer people get on—until a rainy night, when someone who shouldn't exist steps aboard.

frontmatter.title: 末班公交
frontmatter.summary: 每晚 11 点 40 分，末班 37 路经过老城区，上来的人越来越少，直到一个雨夜，上来了一个不该存在的人。

frontmatter.title: After the Last Bus
frontmatter.summary: He missed the last bus and found an old man waiting at the stop. Both knew no bus was coming, yet neither got up to leave.

frontmatter.title: 末班车之后
frontmatter.summary: 错过了末班车，站台上还有一个等车的老人。两个人都知道已经没有车了，但没有人起身离开。

frontmatter.title: The Last Bus
frontmatter.summary: A night bus driver notices a woman who gets off every night at a vacant lot demolished five years ago. He follows her and finds something under an old locust tree.

frontmatter.title: 末班车
frontmatter.summary: 43路末班车司机老周发现，有个女人每晚都在一片已拆除五年的空地下车。他跟上去，在老槐树下看到了不该看到的东西。

frontmatter.title: The Elevator’s Last Call
frontmatter.summary: On the eve of retirement, an elevator mechanic takes one last job: an old lift that stops at the seventh floor every night at 2:17.

frontmatter.title: 最后一趟电梯
frontmatter.summary: 老周退休前接到最后一单报修：一部总在凌晨停靠七楼的旧电梯。

frontmatter.title: The Last Recording at Cathay Theatre
frontmatter.summary: A sound engineer hired to document a century-old theatre before demolition captures something in the silence—a voice that has been waiting since 1948.

frontmatter.title: 国泰剧院最后的录音
frontmatter.summary: 一个录音师在老剧院拆除前夕录制声音档案，却在空无一人的剧场里捕捉到了来自1948年的唱腔。

frontmatter.title: The Last Stop
frontmatter.summary: For three years, an old woman took the last bus every night without fail. Then one evening, she didn't. The driver went looking.

frontmatter.title: 最后一站
frontmatter.summary: 末班公交车司机老吴发现，那个三年来每天准时上车的老太太突然不来了。他决定去找她。

frontmatter.title: The Lock That Would Not Turn
frontmatter.summary: A landlady hires locksmith Old Meng to replace a tenant’s lock while he is at work. Then someone coughs behind the door.

frontmatter.title: 拧不动的锁
frontmatter.summary: 锁匠老孟受房东委托，趁租客上班时换掉门锁。那把锁却怎么也拧不下来。

frontmatter.title: The Loyal Dog
frontmatter.summary: The black dog Wuzhui gives his body to save his drunken master from fire, and guards the grave three years after—villagers raise a stone for his righteousness.

frontmatter.title: 义犬
frontmatter.summary: 黑犬乌锥舍身救醉主于火，主人殁后守坟三年，乡人立石以志其义。

frontmatter.title: The Marginalia
frontmatter.summary: Twenty-four secondhand books, forty years of penciled notes—and a stranger's life pieced together between the margins.

frontmatter.title: 批注
frontmatter.summary: 一箱旧书里的铅笔字迹，拼凑出一个陌生人从青年到暮年的四十年。

frontmatter.title: The Married Tree
frontmatter.summary: The newly widowed Lady Cui weeps each night at the old riverside camphor, until the trunk splits and quietly takes her to wife.

frontmatter.title: 古木
frontmatter.summary: 新寡崔氏每夜抱河边老樟而泣，树干裂隙，竟将她悄然娶去。

frontmatter.title: The Mountain Ghost
frontmatter.summary: On a rainy night in a ruined shrine, a tea-merchant meets a mountain ghost who has waited ten years — and finds the living far more faithless.

frontmatter.title: 山鬼
frontmatter.summary: 雨夜废庙，茶客遇一等候亡夫十年的山中女鬼，却揭开人间更薄情。

frontmatter.title: The Mountain Spirit
frontmatter.summary: A woodcutter befriends a hairy mountain spirit who carries his wood by night and brings ginseng through the snow.

frontmatter.title: 山魈
frontmatter.summary: 樵夫王二夜遇山魈，毛群相助，雪夜赠参，一段淡而久的交情。

frontmatter.title: The Night Pharmacy
frontmatter.summary: At 2:40 a.m. a man in a reversed raincoat comes for expired nitroglycerin, and the pharmacist Lin Sui says nothing.

frontmatter.title: 深夜药房
frontmatter.summary: 凌晨两点四十，一个穿反穿雨衣的男人来买过期的硝酸甘油，药剂师林穗没有拆穿他。

frontmatter.title: The Ninth Floor
frontmatter.summary: In an old apartment building's elevator, a button appears for a floor that doesn't exist. After twenty years of fixing elevators, Lao Zhou doesn't know which button to press anymore.

frontmatter.title: 九楼
frontmatter.summary: 一栋老楼的电梯里多了一个不存在的楼层按钮，修了二十年电梯的老周，第一次不知道该按哪个。

frontmatter.title: The Old Man Who Bought Water
frontmatter.summary: A girl on the night shift at a convenience store, an old man who shows up every night to buy water and cigarettes. Between them: a bottle, a pack, and the whole span of midnight.

frontmatter.title: 半夜来买水的老人
frontmatter.summary: 一个便利店夜班女孩，一个每晚准时来买矿泉水和烟的老人。他们之间隔着一瓶水、一包烟和整个午夜的距离。

frontmatter.title: The Old News
frontmatter.summary: For five years, he walked past the old newspaper vendor without a word. Then he noticed the papers were dated 1997.

frontmatter.title: 旧报
frontmatter.summary: 他在地铁站里走了五年，从来没有跟那个卖报老人说过一句话。直到有一天，他发现老人卖的报纸日期停在了一九九七年。

frontmatter.title: The Painted Wall
frontmatter.summary: At midnight the painted maidens step from the temple wall; a youth follows and finds his self no longer his own.

frontmatter.title: 画壁
frontmatter.summary: 寺壁天女夜半走出，少年随之入画，惊觉身非己有，魂寄于壁。

frontmatter.title: The Puppet
frontmatter.summary: A troupe's wooden figure, at one scene in 'The Parting Pavilion,' begins to move of its own accord.

frontmatter.title: 傀儡
frontmatter.summary: 戏班木偶演到《离亭》一出，竟自己动了起来，掩面而泣。

frontmatter.title: The River God
frontmatter.summary: A ferryman is charged by the River God to guide a drowned youth's body home through a midnight storm.

frontmatter.title: 河伯
frontmatter.summary: 渡口舟子雾夜遇河伯，受托引一具浮尸归岸，以还倚闾之母。

frontmatter.title: The River Lantern
frontmatter.summary: On the fifteenth of the seventh month, a youth sets river lanterns adrift and meets the drowned Lady Liu come to claim one.

frontmatter.title: 河灯
frontmatter.summary: 七月半，一人放河灯，竟遇去岁溺水的柳氏女来讨一盏。

frontmatter.title: The Snake Doctor
frontmatter.summary: He spared a wounded serpent; in time it bore an herb to save his dying mother.

frontmatter.title: 蛇医
frontmatter.summary: 救一伤蛇，他日蛇衔药来，救其垂死之母。

frontmatter.title: The Sound
frontmatter.summary: A foley artist working late nights keeps hearing an impossible humming in his recordings—a nameless tune his late wife used to sing.

frontmatter.title: 响
frontmatter.summary: 一个拟音师在深夜录音时，反复听到一段不该存在的哼唱——那是他已故妻子生前最爱的无名小调。

frontmatter.title: The Stone Ferry
frontmatter.summary: Upon the Green Creek a bridge appears only on the month's last night and in storms, to lead the dead across; at cockcrow it is gone.

frontmatter.title: 石渡
frontmatter.summary: 青溪有桥，只在晦日与风雨夜浮现，引亡魂过河，鸡鸣则没。

frontmatter.title: The Tea Hag
frontmatter.summary: A lone old woman keeps a wayside tea shed by night; only next day do travelers learn she was no mortal.

frontmatter.title: 茶婆
frontmatter.summary: 荒村野茶棚独坐老妪，饮者次日方悟其非人。

frontmatter.title: The Thing in the Wall
frontmatter.summary: An old man returns to his soon-to-be-demolished house to retrieve something he sealed in the wall forty years ago. What he finds is not what you'd expect, and not quite what he remembered.

frontmatter.title: 墙里的东西
frontmatter.summary: 老房子要拆了。四十年前，他把一个铁盒子封进了卧室的墙里。现在墙要倒了，他必须回去把它取出来。

frontmatter.title: Bed Three
frontmatter.summary: A night nurse at a county hospital dreads the footsteps at 1 a.m.—Old Wei has come again to bring congee to his late wife.

frontmatter.title: 三床
frontmatter.summary: 县医院夜班护士最怕凌晨一点的脚步声——那是老魏又来给亡妻送粥了。

frontmatter.title: The Third Kind of Silence, That Summer
frontmatter.summary: After a class reunion, two middle-aged men drink at a late-night barbecue stall. They talk all night, but no one says her name.

frontmatter.title: 那年夏天的第三种沉默
frontmatter.summary: 同学会后，两个中年男人在凌晨的烧烤摊喝酒。他们聊了一整晚，但没人提那个名字。

frontmatter.title: Three Minutes at the Cooler
frontmatter.summary: Every night at 2 a.m., a man in a gray suit stands before the cooler for exactly three minutes, buys nothing, and leaves. I followed the trail to a reason no purchase could ever satisfy.

frontmatter.title: 冷柜前的三分钟
frontmatter.summary: 每天凌晨两点，他准时出现在便利店冷柜前，站三分钟，什么也不买。我跟踪他，发现了一个不需要购买任何东西的理由。

frontmatter.title: The Thunder God
frontmatter.summary: A filial-less son hides from the storm beneath a tree; the thunder-god splits the tree but spares the man, and leaves a verse behind.

frontmatter.title: 雷神
frontmatter.summary: 一不孝子雷夜藏树下避罚，雷神劈树不劈人，留偈而去。

frontmatter.title: The Tree Spirit
frontmatter.summary: A thousand-year tree guards a village's well; the woodcutter who trespasses finds his axe will not bite, and the well turns green.

frontmatter.title: 树精
frontmatter.summary: 千年老树护一村井水，伐木者触犯，斧不入而井生苔。

frontmatter.title: The Turtle Spirit
frontmatter.summary: An ancient turtle in the pond takes an old man's shape by night to play at go; lose a single game, and the rains fall out of season.

frontmatter.title: 鳖精
frontmatter.summary: 塘中老鳖成精，夜化老翁与人弈，输一局便旱涝失调。

frontmatter.title: The VHS Tape
frontmatter.summary: A maintenance worker finds a VHS tape from 1998 hidden above a bathroom ceiling. The apartment in the footage is the same one he has called home for twenty years.

frontmatter.title: 录像带
frontmatter.summary: 一个物业维修工在天花板夹层里发现了一盒1998年的录像带，带子里拍的那间屋子，就是他住了二十年的家。

frontmatter.title: The Village God
frontmatter.summary: The god of a ruined shrine shows his power not for sacrifice, but only to save a village's festival play—goodness seen in small things.

frontmatter.title: 社公
frontmatter.summary: 荒庙土地神显灵，不为祭享，只为一村社日之戏，小事见真性情。

frontmatter.title: The Well Voice
frontmatter.summary: An ancient village well speaks at midnight; the woodcutter descends by rope and finds two sunk skeletons pleading an old wrong.

frontmatter.title: 井语
frontmatter.summary: 村中古井夜半作人语，樵夫缒绳下探，方知是两具沉骨在诉旧冤。

frontmatter.title: The Woman Who Came at Two in the Morning
frontmatter.summary: She came at 2 AM every night, buying only water and White Rabbit candy. Three months without missing a day. Then one night she didn't show up, and I learned the truth from someone else.

frontmatter.title: 凌晨两点的客人
frontmatter.summary: 凌晨两点准时出现的女人，每次只买矿泉水和奶糖，三个月来一天没落过。直到那天她没来，我才从别人口中听到了真相。

frontmatter.title: The Wuchang
frontmatter.summary: A dying miser is visited by the black-and-white Wuchang; for one unspent kindness, his soul is granted a reprieve.

frontmatter.title: 无常
frontmatter.summary: 将死富户夜见黑白无常，因一桩未偿之善，勾魂竟得延期。

frontmatter.title: The Yecha
frontmatter.summary: A sea demon guards the fishing boats each night — for the sake of a kindness owed thirty years before.

frontmatter.title: 夜叉
frontmatter.summary: 滨海渔村，夜叉夜夜护舟，竟因一桩三十年前的旧恩。

frontmatter.title: The Beer at Three in the Morning
frontmatter.summary: A convenience store night-shift clerk notices a man who buys the same beer every night at 3 a.m. He never drinks it—he pours it into a flowerbed at the bus stop across the street.

frontmatter.title: 凌晨三点的啤酒
frontmatter.summary: 便利店夜班店员注意到一位每天凌晨三点准时买同一款啤酒的男人。他从不喝它，而是带去街对面的公交站，倒进花坛里。

frontmatter.title: Three in the Morning
frontmatter.summary: Every night at exactly 3 a.m., a man walks into a convenience store and buys the same beer. When the clerk finally asks him why, the answer takes three years to arrive.

frontmatter.title: 凌晨三点
frontmatter.summary: 深夜便利店里，一个男人每晚凌晨三点准时来买同一款啤酒。店员终于问了他一句——但这个问题的答案，比他想象的要晚三年。

frontmatter.title: Three-Ten
frontmatter.summary: Every night at 3:10 AM, she walked into the convenience store. Same water, same tissues. Never opened either. Then one night, she bought beer.

frontmatter.title: 三点十分
frontmatter.summary: 凌晨三点的便利店，一个永不缺席的女人，和一瓶从未真正喝过的水。

frontmatter.summary: An old electrician has fixed everything in thirty-three years—except one thing.

frontmatter.summary: 一个老电工修了一辈子电路，只有一件事他始终没修好。

frontmatter.title: Two Fifteen AM
frontmatter.summary: A convenience store night clerk notices that the woman who comes every night at 2:15 AM for a tuna onigiri and milk suddenly stops showing up. Two weeks later, a young man walks in at the exact same time.

frontmatter.title: 凌晨两点十五分
frontmatter.summary: 便利店夜班店员小陈注意到，每天凌晨两点十五分准时来买金枪鱼饭团和牛奶的女人，突然不再出现了。两周后，一个年轻男人在同样的时间推门进来。

frontmatter.title: The Clam Maid
frontmatter.summary: A-Liu of Lijiang saves a great clam from the fishing bully and rows it home to the sea by night; a blind mother is healed by a strange woman, and for three years a quiet bond holds — until Pearl, who is the clam, repays the debt and returns to the water.

frontmatter.title: 蚌女
frontmatter.summary: 蛎江渔人阿留救巨蚌于渔霸之手，夜送归海；后盲母得女子相救复明，三载恩侣，珠娘自言本蚌，化形报恩，悄然归水。

frontmatter.title: The Crow God
frontmatter.summary: An old crow nests in Stone Gate Town's great locust and caws the night before any disaster. The watchman Old Qin reads its alarms and saves the town from fire; after his death his nephew Young Qin scorns it, until a snowy night the crow's frantic caw reveals bandits at the pass, and the town ambushes them. The crow vanishes with the thaw. The town carves a nameless stone crow at the tree. The Chronicler: the crow cried not doom but 'wake'.

frontmatter.title: 鸦神
frontmatter.summary: 镇西古槐栖一老鸦，镇人谓之鸦神。每逢将有灾，夜半哑哑急噪。更夫老秦能解其意。某年雪夜，群盗将袭，老鸦连噪窗前，老秦率众伏隘，尽擒之。后老秦殁，鸦亦不至。镇人立小碑于槐下，不题名，但刻一鸦。

frontmatter.title: The Fox Monk
frontmatter.summary: At Bao-xiang Temple the fat abbot Hui-ming skims the incense-money and books the pilgrims' offerings onto his own stove. A traveling monk arrives in the rain and, with a few quiet words, turns his thefts back on him; at departure he leaves the bowl fuller than before, and one fiery fox-hair. The Chronicler: the robe may cloak the belly, but not the amber in the eye.

frontmatter.title: 狐僧
frontmatter.summary: 宝相寺住持慧明中饱香油钱，侵香客供品。秋雨中一缁衣行脚僧投宿，以清眼与数语，屡次将他的贪显于当下；临去，铜钵钱一文不减反多两贯，上粘一茎火红狐毛。慧明自此不敢动佛前钱。狐也怕佛，佛也怕狐，两下相安。

frontmatter.title: The Frog God
frontmatter.summary: Stone-Bank worships a giant frog as the Frog God and is answered with rain in drought; the unbelieving rich man Qian fills the pool and tears down the shrine, and is drowned in water and frogs, ruined by failed harvests, while the honest orphan Stone is repaid and his mother healed.

frontmatter.title: 蛙神
frontmatter.summary: 石陂村祀巨蛙为蛙神，旱时祈雨得应；富户钱翁不信，填陂拆庙，反遭水淹蛙噪、连岁歉收而破家；孤子阿石敬水得报，母病获救。

frontmatter.title: The Kitchen God
frontmatter.summary: The neighbors call sharp-tongued mistress Liu Zhou-shi 'Lady Liu the Judge of Hell,' yet each winter she secretly feeds and clothes the homeless and alone buries a nameless floater. Her shallow son tries to bribe the Kitchen God with malt-sugar and a red card to report only the family's virtues. The Chronicler: the god records not what men wish, but the bowl of water, the two cakes, the basket at the bridge-mouth.

frontmatter.title: 灶君
frontmatter.summary: 镇西柳家当家的柳周氏性烈口苛，邻人呼为“柳阎王”；却每冬暗济桥洞穷丐、独葬无名浮尸，无人知晓。其子柳承浮滑，辞灶夜备糖瓜红帖，欲买灶君之口只言家善。灶君上天照实而奏，天庭旌其“暗室不欺”。糖瓜甜不得嘴，清水与糕才入账。

frontmatter.title: The Merfolk
frontmatter.summary: A fisherman's soft-hearted grandfather once freed a wounded merfolk, who left a tear-mark on his palm. Years later, when the grandson's ailing daughter needs costly medicine, the merfolk returns each great tide to weep pearls in repayment — until a greedy villager traps her, the fisherman cuts her free, and her numbered tears run out. The Chronicler: a debt of tears, once spent, leaves only the sea.

frontmatter.title: 鲛人
frontmatter.summary: 蛎浦渔人沈阿礁承了祖父掌心一道鲛人泪痕。待女儿阿菱病重、需百金参药时，当年被救的鲛人于每度大潮浮海而来，以泪化珠相偿。屠户窥见起贪，撒网困之；阿礁割网放生。次年菱儿病愈，所积珠恰够药资，再无余。珠尽人隐，海潮如旧，再无人影浮起。

frontmatter.title: The Plague God
frontmatter.summary: For three years Wei-nan county starves, yet its magistrate hides the famine as a bumper harvest to save his career and keeps taxing the dying. The Plague God is sent to punish, but finding villagers share their last bowl while clerks feast, he marks only the guilty doors. The Chronicler: heaven's pestilence is not random cruelty but a reckoning of debts men owe.

frontmatter.title: 瘟神
frontmatter.summary: 渭南连旱三年，县令王弼瞒荒报丰，照旧征粮，饿殍遍野。行疫之神下界，见田埂上乡人匀食、县衙里官饮，遂只于点污之门落疫，独赦穷民。年底御史实奏，开仓放赈。瘟神收的是拿饿殍换前程者所欠之账，非嗜杀也。

frontmatter.title: The Rat Wedding
frontmatter.summary: On the seventeenth-night rat-wedding, the skeptical granary-keeper Old Gou waits with his clapper to catch the thieves, and instead beholds the rats in lanterns and finery bearing their daughter in a melon-seed-shell chair — and is given three strange grains.

frontmatter.title: 鼠嫁
frontmatter.summary: 正月十七“老鼠嫁女”之夜，守仓人老苟不信旧俗，提梆守洞欲擒鼠，却亲见鼠群执灯结彩、以瓜子壳为轿送女过门，并得三粒异谷。

frontmatter.title: The Silkworm God
frontmatter.summary: All in Cocoon Bridge Town rear silkworms and honor the Horse-Head Maiden. Diligent Widow Zhou keeps the old rites and her cocoons come heavy; young Qian Gui scorns the offerings to save coin, and his cocoons come hollow. A dream shows him the goddess asking if she covets his meat. He mends the shrine, keeps the rites, and his silk thrives. The Chronicler: the goddess punishes a slack heart, not a thin gift.

frontmatter.title: 蚕神
frontmatter.summary: 茧桥镇蚕户奉蚕神马头娘，春祭必诚。周娘子守旧礼，蚕花繁盛；钱贵轻慢，欲省祭礼多取利，茧多空瘪。一梦蚕神示警，钱贵悔而重修小庙，来年丝丰。自此每春首叶，必焚一炷香。

frontmatter.title: The Snail Maid
frontmatter.summary: The orphan Xie Duan finds a great green-gold snail and keeps it. From then on his stove is lit and his floor swept when he returns; he hides and sees a water-robed maid step from the shell. She is sent by heaven to tend his kitchen, but seen, she must return; she leaves the shell, which ever holds a little grain in lean times. He never marries, keeps the shell, and lives out his days. The Chronicler: the poor lack not wealth but warmth.

frontmatter.title: 螺女
frontmatter.summary: 谢端少孤，独居临水。一日于河滩得巨螺，养之瓮中。自此后，归家则炊已熟、地已扫。潜窥之，见一女子自螺壳中出，执炊事。女子自言白水之女，天帝怜其勤而遣来相济；今既为人所见，缘尽当归。临去留壳，言持此虽贫不饥。谢端终身不娶，守壳以老。

frontmatter.title: The Snake Groom
frontmatter.summary: Old Wei frees a green snake that returns as the Snake Groom to wed his youngest, Third Maid; the jealous eldest, Yun, drowns her sister and takes her place, but is betrayed by the bracelet's mark on the true wrist, and is turned to the Wronged Bird.

frontmatter.title: 蛇郎
frontmatter.summary: 韦翁救青蛇，蛇化蛇郎报恩娶其三女三娘；长女阿芸妒而害妹冒名，终因腕上无镯痕败露，蛇郎抱尸归谷，阿芸化为怨鸟。

frontmatter.title: The Tiger Matchmaker
frontmatter.summary: Old Cui, a hunter, once freed a tiger's throat; years later his daughter dies. A tiger haunts her grave, then in a great snow carries a lost young peddler, Yu Sheng, to Cui's door. Cui keeps him; the tiger, he says, is matchmaker for his dead girl, bringing a son-in-law to tend his age. Yu Sheng weds the girl's sworn sister; the tiger vanishes, but each year a long call rises from the ridge. The Chronicler: the surest matchmaker need not be human.

frontmatter.title: 虎媒
frontmatter.summary: 青崖岭有虎，尝衔良配至人家，乡人谓之虎媒。崔翁失女阿绫，曾活一虎；虎报恩，于风雪夜负迷途客俞生至崔家，又引阿绫魂归。俞生感其意，留而佐崔翁，年余与邻女成礼。虎不复至，唯崖畔偶闻一声长啸。
